title: ビジネス統計学Ⅰ
subtitle: Business Statistics I
educationalGoal:
This course is for achieving the "marketing ability" of the learning and education goals of the Department of Management Informatics.
We aim to develop the ability to extract information necessary for management by correctly applying "statistics" of techniques essential for analyzing business problems.
advice: In this course, students will deepen their understanding of the relationship between statistics and business, and acquire the ability to understand the basic concepts of statistics and the practical skills through exercises. In addition, since Excel is used as a simple task and data collection and the data analysis in the exercise, it is necessary to bring each computer every time.
requiredKnowledge: Students should studied the "Statistics for Engineers"and  know the basics of Excel. In addition,ability to use basic knowledge of management and the relationship between management and statistical data.

achievementLevels.ideal: You can understand various statistical theories and use them correctly. You can use Excel freely. In addition, it is possible to select, collect, and analyze data for specific management issues, and extract useful information for solving problems through the consideration of the results.
achievementLevels.standard: You can understand various statistical theories and use the technique using Excel. Furthermore, it is possible to explain the relationship between the specific management issues and the given data and analysis methods.
